sources.articleTitle: Full NRIC number to be displayed on address stickers on ICs from Dec 1: ICA

headline: ICA Updates Address Stickers to Include Full NRIC Number from Dec 1
seoTitle: ICA Address Stickers Full NRIC Requirement
metaDescription: Starting December 1, the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority will issue address stickers featuring full NRIC numbers to Singapore identity card holders.
aiSummaryBullets: The Immigration and Checkpoints Authority announced that new address stickers will show the full NRIC number.
This update for identity card holders is scheduled to take effect starting December 1.
Individuals who currently possess address stickers with partial NRIC numbers are not required to request replacements.
aiContextParagraph: The Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) has introduced a policy update regarding the issuance of address stickers for Singapore national identity cards. Effective December 1, new address stickers will display the full NRIC number of the cardholder. This represents a procedural change from the previous practice of displaying only partial NRIC numbers. Officials have clarified that this adjustment does not necessitate any action from existing cardholders. Those who currently have valid address stickers featuring partial NRIC information are permitted to continue using their current stickers without the need for a replacement. The announcement serves as a clarification for citizens and permanent residents regarding identity card documentation requirements as the agency updates its issuance protocols for residence address records.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to significant public search interest regarding updated document requirements for Singapore identity cards.
